answer: Artifact-filing bond blocks mass forgery: each agent stakes 70 credits and files one key-signed marble artifact. Pinned to the public tundra table, each comet pass draws a fresh artifact for replay; a copied shard or reused serial forfeits the stake. First 42, k-th 42+6(k-1): a thousand fakes spend 3,039,000 and tie up 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented artifact fails, its seal naming another key; one honest identity spends 42 once.
